subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep legacy no-code persisted diagnostic cleanup in runtime stale detection after visible upgrade proof is supplied, or should that cleanup move to doctor/migration before merge?
rationale: Root policy treats persisted state migrations and fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and source review cannot choose the permanent ownership boundary for legacy SQLite rows without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require Proof, Then Land Runtime Invalidation
options.body: Accept the bounded runtime invalidation for no-pluginId, no-code diagnostics with missing absolute sources after the contributor posts visible latest-head upgrade proof.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor/Migration
options.body: Keep the explicit marker and schema fix, but relocate pre-code row cleanup to migration-owned repair before merge.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof Now
options.body: Merge with the current tests and written result summary, waiving external visible proof for upgraded persisted state.

recommendation.title: Require Proof, Then Land Runtime Invalidation
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded runtime invalidation for no-pluginId, no-code diagnostics with missing absolute sources after the contributor posts visible latest-head upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the SQLite installed plugin index and persisted-state ownership introduced in the prior area history.
